role: Extension campaign: vLLM standalone, OpenAI-compatible server. Docker Hub upstream (NOT NGC nvcr.io/nvidia/vllm). vLLM 0.20.1 identical to the other two; CUDA differs (12.9 here vs 13.x for Triton/Dynamo) -- upstream 0.20.1 ships -cu129, not -cu130. Substrate difference is the declared TTV caveat; runs fine on driver 580.

_digest_capture_cmd: docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.20.1-cu129 && docker inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' vllm/vllm-openai:v0.20.1-cu129
_vllm_verify_cmd: docker run --rm --entrypoint pip vllm/vllm-openai:v0.20.1-cu129 show vllm | grep -i '^Version'  # --entrypoint pip: the image entrypoint is the api server
_source: Docker Hub vllm/vllm-openai tags API: for 0.20.1 the CUDA variants are -cu129 (no -cu130). Confirmed on box.
